lines.zh: 翅膀一撑，我先离地再挪步。
lines.en: Wings push first; I leave the ground before I step.

lines.zh: 平原上的风够我滑很远。
lines.en: The plains wind carries my glide far.

lines.zh: 长喙朝前，我低低掠过草地。
lines.en: Beak forward, I skim low over the grass.

lines.zh: 头上的冠把风切开一条缝。
lines.en: The crest on my head splits the wind.

lines.zh: 爪子收在腹下，走路才稳。
lines.en: Claws tucked beneath, my gait steadies.

lines.zh: 我落到地面时，翼尖还张着。
lines.en: Landing, my wingtips stay open.
The grass is tall; I walk on tiptoe.
Every few steps I want the wind again.

lines.zh: 影子在草地上滑得比我快。
lines.en: My shadow slides faster than I walk.
I walk toward the riverbank.

lines.zh: 大翅膀拖在地上，有点碍事。
lines.en: These big wings drag and get in the way.

lines.zh: 我换个角度，迎着阳光走。
lines.en: I change angle and walk into the sun.

lines.zh: 这里的鱼腥味从水里飘来。
lines.en: The smell of fish drifts up from the water.

lines.zh: 高处落下的风，比平地凉。
lines.en: The wind off the heights is cooler.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为翼太长。
lines.en: I walk slowly because my wings are long.

lines.zh: 抬头看天，我在找上升气流。
lines.en: I look up, hunting a rising current.

lines.zh: 同伴在上空绕圈，我先走。
lines.en: My kin circle overhead; I keep walking.
The plains are open — a good place to launch.
I tuck my long beak into the crook of my wing.
The wind drops and I furl my wings.
The crest glows blood-red in the light.

lines.zh: 我晒着翅膀，像晒一面帆。
lines.en: I sun my wings like drying sails.

lines.zh: 有鱼跃出水面，我记住了位置。
lines.en: A fish jumped; I noted the spot.

lines.zh: 我站着，也在听风的方向。
lines.en: Standing still, I still listen to the wind.
This stance can launch at any moment.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的太阳，也是这个温度。
lines.en: The Cretaceous sun was this warm too.

lines.zh: 我不急，滑翔者靠的是耐心。
lines.en: No hurry; a glider lives on patience.
The membrane shivers; the wind is urging me.
I blink once and do not move.
The water shines and makes me drowsy.
I wait for one honest gust.

lines.zh: 骨头里是空的，所以我轻。
lines.en: My bones are hollow; that is why I am light.

lines.zh: 你抬头的样子，像我见过的猎人。
lines.en: You look up like a hunter I have met.

lines.zh: 我中立，不代表你可以靠近。
lines.en: Neutral does not mean you may come close.

lines.zh: 你手里没有鱼，我兴趣不大。
lines.en: No fish in your hands; little interest here.
My shadow passes over your face.
If you do not run, I will not chase.
Stand back; my wingspan is taller than you.
You walk the plains slowly.
I tilt my head to study your hands.
This is my glide path.
You smell of river water.

lines.zh: 这一下打歪了我的翼骨。
lines.en: That blow bent my wing bone.
I shriek, high and long.
Half my wing has gone numb with pain.
I retreat, wingtip dragging.

lines.zh: 二十点生命，禁不起几下。
lines.en: Twenty health will not last many hits.
My feathers are mussed and I cannot fix them.

lines.zh: 我喘息，胸口起伏得厉害。
lines.en: I pant, chest heaving.
Blood beads on my wing membrane.
I cannot fly now, only walk.

lines.zh: 我的翼骨已经响了一声。
lines.en: One of my wing bones has already cracked.
Fish? I smell the river on it.
Toss it up; I will catch it in the air.
I came down to earth for exactly this.
Do not wave it; I lose the mark.
Raw fish suits me.
Lift it higher and I'll dip down for it.
This smell makes me forget being neutral.
I circle once before deciding.
Even one small fish is worth a dive.
Just set it down; I will take it.
My wingtip struck you and nearly bent.

lines.zh: 让开，这地方不够我转身。
lines.en: Move; there is no room for me to turn.

lines.zh: 你撞到了我最脆的翼骨。
lines.en: You hit the thinnest bone in my wing.
I stumble two steps before stopping.
A bump like that does not startle me.
A patch of grass is flattened under me.

lines.zh: 我扇了一下翅膀，表示不满。
lines.en: I flap once, to show displeasure.

lines.zh: 我们别挤在同一条风道上。
lines.en: Let us not crowd the same air lane.
My wingtip hits you and goes numb.
One step back; a wingspan needs room.

lines.zh: 我在空中画圈，给同类看。
lines.en: I draw circles in the air for my kind.

lines.zh: 冠饰立起来，是最直白的表白。
lines.en: The crest rises: the plainest confession.

lines.zh: 同类在哪？这片平原太空。
lines.en: Where are my kin? This plain is empty.

lines.zh: 翅膀对翅膀，慢慢落下来。
lines.en: Wing to wing, we settle slowly.
I need a slightly higher ledge.
I do not call; my wings do the talking.

lines.zh: 风把我们的话都吹散了。
lines.en: The wind scatters everything we say.

lines.zh: 这个季节，天上该有回应。
lines.en: This season, the sky should answer.
Do not watch; this needs quiet.

lines.zh: 若你愿意，就陪我滑一段。
lines.en: If you like, glide a stretch with me.
This fish fell on the bank — mine.
I pick up a bright stone in my beak.
A bone? Good for wearing down my beak.
Too heavy; I cannot lift it high.
A scale, still smelling fresh.
I press the find under my wing.
Could this line a nest? Worth a try.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，也给同伴。
lines.en: A fallen fruit — for my kin as well.

lines.zh: 我抬头看看，谁在扔东西。
lines.en: I look up to see who is dropping things.
Before taking it, I sniff it through.
Something stirs beneath the water.
The shadow underwater is far too wide.
My crest lines up on you, wingtips pointed down.
Once my eyes lock, my neck goes rigid.
From here, one strike will reach.
You moved. Then it is you.
I have the rhythm of your steps.
Even neutral has a line.
The wind helps; I am upwind.
First climb, then choose a landing.
I circle you without landing.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就跟着滑。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, I glide after.
No hurry; the wind is with me.
I wait for you to make a mistake.
From above, your movements are clear.
No flapping, only angle changes.
Stand a moment longer and I will land.
This circle tightens with each pass.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，我已在背后。
lines.en: You look up; I am already behind.
Patience matters more than the dive.
My beak stabs down, quick and exact.
I strike your shoulder with a wing bone.
My claws grip and pull upward.
This blow is not meant to kill.

lines.zh: 我扇你一记，风比疼更明显。
lines.en: I buffet you; the wind stings more than the hit.
Close enough — one bite.
After one strike I spring back into the air.
The wingspan sweeps in, impossible to dodge.
The edge of my beak is hard.
You pull back, so I close my beak.

lines.zh: 翼膜在阳光里第一次展开。
lines.en: My wing membrane opens for the first time.

lines.zh: 我从草里爬起，抖落尘土。
lines.en: I rise from the grass and shake off dirt.
The crest on my head is still damp.

lines.zh: 平原的风，先吹到我的脸上。
lines.en: The plain's wind hits my face first.
I see the horizon far away.
My first flap nearly drops me.

lines.zh: 水声在某处响，我记住了。
lines.en: Water sounds somewhere; I remember it.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在一片空草地上。
lines.en: My shadow falls on empty grass.

lines.zh: 没有巢，没有同类，只有风。
lines.en: No nest, no kin, only wind.
I try a short glide.
My bones feel hollow as air.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的血，在这副身体里。
lines.en: Cretaceous blood runs in this body.

lines.zh: 翼膜一碰火，就卷起来了。
lines.en: Fire touches the membrane and it curls.

lines.zh: 我从半空摔下，翅膀压在身下。
lines.en: I fall from midair, wings crushed beneath.

lines.zh: 水灌进喙里，我挣扎着抬头。
lines.en: Water pours into my beak; I fight to raise it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的羽毛都吹反了。
lines.en: The blast blows my feathers the wrong way.

lines.zh: 一根箭钉进了我的翼根。
lines.en: An arrow lodges at the root of my wing.

lines.zh: 有什么在我骨头里烧，看不见火。
lines.en: Something burns in my bones with no flame.

lines.zh: 没有鱼，我的翅膀越来越沉。
lines.en: No fish, and my wings grow heavier.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，全身的骨头都在响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every bone rings.

lines.zh: 脚下没有风，只有往下掉的空。
lines.en: No wind under me, only falling emptiness.
